name: Konoe Rui
source:
Code name: L.
Calm and acts cold, he firmly believes he is doing the right thing/has his own sense of justice.
He is tiny but is capable of close combat with the sword.

He is a police officer when not on missions for Ark, he's kind and popular with the elderly and children.
